page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The hardware configuration includes 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 positions this instance as a memory-dense resource. The dedicated core allocation ensures predictable compute performance without virtualization overhead from hyperthreading. This profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database deployments, in-memory caching, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM capacity alongside high-frequency physical processing cores.
